limitations: The 2020 esports title list includes only titles ranked in the top 25 for total esports tournament prize money.
Projected state counts reflect states that legalized sports betting by year-end, not necessarily states where betting had launched.
The sports-rights chart covers regular-season deals only, excludes league-owned channels, and reflects information as of October 2021. Turner had an HBO Max option but had not scheduled live games.
The esports-viewer measure differs by year: 2021 counts adults who watched a competition in the previous 12 months, while 2019–2020 counts adults who had watched at any time.
The gaming-company presence table reflects information as of October 6, 2021, and excludes areas where the company is a majority stakeholder.
A reported acquisition value is identified as approximate.
